HORIZON-UNIFORM FINITE-POPULATION THEOREM (source-reported)
For integer P≥1, let H=binom(P+d−1,d−1), a_P=d/(2P), and b_P=d/(Pα+d). Vertices are state histograms x∈N^Q of total P.
